description: Publish a project to the public internet on the MisarDev runtime (optionally at a chosen subdomain). The site becomes reachable by anyone. Confirm with the user before calling, check the address first with check_subdomain, and follow with get_deployment_status. Counts against the plan's deploy quota.

public_gallery.description: List the published app in the public showcase (omit to leave unchanged)

subdomain.description: Subdomain label to publish at (e.g. 'my-app'); omit to keep the current one

name: deploy_project
